channel.title: Veeam Data Cloud Changelog — Microsoft 365
channel.description: Unofficial feed of the Veeam Data Cloud changelog — Veeam Data Cloud Changelog — Microsoft 365

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 New Search Experience Enhancements
item.guid: m365|2026-08-12|Microsoft 365 New Search Experience Enhancements
item.description: • The New Search experience for Exchange now includes the ability to search across all restore points for a specific user mailbox. This feature is available to all customers who have already received the New Search experience, which is expected to reach all customers by the end of 2026.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Regional Expansion and Role Permission Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-08-11|Microsoft 365 Regional Expansion and Role Permission Improvements
item.description: • Added Malaysia West as a new backup and storage region in the Asia Pacific area. The region is now available in the backup region and storage region dropdowns during onboarding, region mapping, and backup policy and repository configuration. • Users with the Backup Operator or Restore Operator role assigned to a managed organization can now open and view that organization's tenant without requiring the Manage Workload Tenant permission. Tenant management actions remain restricted to users with the appropriate permissions.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Multi-Geo, Search, and UI Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-08-03|Microsoft 365 Multi-Geo, Search, and UI Improvements
item.description: • Extended Flex Multi-Geo support to Veeam Cloud and Service Provider (VCSP) tenants. Previously available for direct organization onboarding only, multi-geo mapping is now supported across the full VCSP onboarding and invite flow, tenant Settings, and backup and restore behavior. • Column visibility settings in table views are now saved per user and tenant, so selections are preserved across page reloads. The first column can no longer be hidden. • Improved the Basic Search experience: a loading indicator and "Still searching…" message are now shown while a search is in progress, and a "Load more results" link replaces the previous load-more banner below the results table.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Onboarding and Restore Notification Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-07-27|Microsoft 365 Onboarding and Restore Notification Improvements
item.description: • When tenant onboarding fails due to an Exchange Online configuration issue, the error is now surfaced in the UI with a clear description and a link to the relevant knowledge base article, allowing customers to resolve the issue without contacting support. • The restore notification detail page now includes the Restore Reason entered by the user when initiating a restore, applying to both Flex and Express restores.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Notification Time Zone Fix
item.guid: m365|2026-07-20|Microsoft 365 Notification Time Zone Fix
item.description: • The Time Zone setting in Settings → Notifications has been moved from user level to tenant level. All notification emails are now sent using the tenant's configured time zone.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Multiple Microsoft 365 Backup Policy and Restore Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-07-07|Multiple Microsoft 365 Backup Policy and Restore Improvements
item.description: • The new features are grouped first by impact, with the restore points viewer and Express exclusions being the most significant new capabilities, followed by enhancements, then fixes last. • Added support for item exclusions in Express protection policies. When creating or editing a policy, users can exclude specific users, groups (Outlook and OneDrive), and SharePoint sites from backup coverage. • Added a View Restore Points action on the Restore page for each top-level object (Mailbox, SharePoint Site, OneDrive, Team). Clicking it opens a side panel listing all available restore points for that object, with date filtering and sorted by most recent. • The Included in backup and Excluded in backup lists in Flex and Express backup policies now display a subtitle showing the email address or site URL beneath each item name, making it easier to distinguish items that share the same display name. • Removed the Reports.Read.All Microsoft Graph permission from the Flex app registration. This permission is no longer required. Existing customers will see this permission removed upon next reauthorization. Organization size discovery during onboarding now uses an updated API. • Corrected several UI text inconsistencies in the backup policy create and edit flows across Flex and Express. • Standardized the appearance of clickable record titles across all table views, and improved hover cursor states on filters, tabs, buttons, and dropdowns throughout the product for a more consistent experience. • Fixed an issue where the Retention period dropdown was hidden when the Manually create policies after onboarding option was selected, causing retention to silently default to 1 year. The retention selection is now always visible for manual policy creation. • Fixed an issue where policy object selection (SharePoint sites, mailboxes, Teams) was limited to approximately 10 items. Larger selections can now be made when configuring backup policies. • Fixed an issue where selecting users from a group in Express Bulk Restore only loaded the first 200 group members, even when the group contained more. All members are now imported. • Fixed an issue where the consumed license count was calculated incorrectly for Premium licenses, causing a mismatch between the displayed total and the combined count of Express- and Flex-protected users. • Fixed an issue where backup notifications were not sent as expected due to an incorrect internal flag validation in the notification service.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Dashboard, VCSP Partner Onboarding, and RBAC Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-06-23|Microsoft 365 Dashboard, VCSP Partner Onboarding, and RBAC Improvements
item.description: • Added a shareable onboarding link for Veeam Cloud and Service Provider (VCSP) partners. A partner generates a link and shares it with the managed customer, who uses it to complete authentication and onboarding without requiring direct access to the partner's credentials. • The redesigned Dashboard UI introduced in 2.0.16 has been rolled out to all customers. • Dashboard widgets and the Audit Center page now show or hide content based on each user's assigned RBAC permissions, ensuring users only see what they are authorized to access. • Added a dismissible in-app notification on the Dashboard informing existing customers that their roles need to be updated with new Dashboard and Audit Center permissions. • Fixed an issue where only the first 20 versions of a SharePoint list item were displayed when selecting a restore point, with no way to load older versions. All available versions are now shown. • Fixed an issue where report notification emails failed to send when multiple recipients were configured. Notifications are now sent to each recipient individually.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Multiple Microsoft 365 Audit, Permissions, and UI Enhancements
item.guid: m365|2026-06-16|Multiple Microsoft 365 Audit, Permissions, and UI Enhancements
item.description: • Added an optional Restore Reason field to the restore dialog for Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams across both Flex and Express plans. The entered reason is recorded in the audit log. • Added an export function to all tabs in the Audit Center, allowing users to download audit data with a configurable date range. • When activating Express Backup, the permission consent request is now scoped to only the permissions not yet granted, rather than requesting the full permission set every time. • The Offboard action is now available only for protection units that have been removed from an Express backup policy, preventing accidental offboarding of active items. • Updated the Manage Notification Settings permission so that users with this permission can view all notifications in the tenant, including notifications belonging to other users and system notifications. • Added the View Protection Status permission to the default Microsoft 365 role template, controlling visibility of the Protection Status widget on the Dashboard. • Updated Dashboard widget titles to Protection Status (Flex) and License Activity (Flex) to better reflect their purpose. • Full notification and backup session log text is now displayed without truncation in the detail panel, removing the need to hover for tooltips. • Removed unused status values (Error, Retry, Warning) from the backup policy list filter and the Flex Backup Sessions filter. • Removed the status filter and status label from the Licensed Users tab. Backup policy enabled/disabled state is now shown in a dedicated Policy Status column. • Updated the in-app EWS deprecation notification to reflect Microsoft's revised deadline. The notification now shows October 1, 2026 as the full EWS deprecation date. • Updated all references from "OneDrive for Business" to "OneDrive" throughout the product, in line with Microsoft's renaming. • Fixed an issue where SharePoint item versions visible during browsing could not be restored. The selected version information is now correctly carried through to the restore session.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Flex Restore Redesign and Backup Fixes
item.guid: m365|2026-06-09|Microsoft 365 Flex Restore Redesign and Backup Fixes
item.description: • The Flex Restore experience for Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams has been redesigned with a refreshed UI, providing a more consistent and streamlined restore workflow. • Added in-app notifications to inform customers about upcoming outbound IP address changes due to infrastructure updates. • Fixed an issue where a transient error from the backup service could incorrectly overwrite the existing mailbox backup status, causing the protection status to appear outdated or incorrect. • Fixed an issue where the default retention period for newly created backup repositories was set to 7 years instead of the correct default of 1 year.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Backup Retention Configuration and UI Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-06-01|Microsoft 365 Backup Retention Configuration and UI Improvements
item.description: • The daily retention period configuration has been improved across all backup repository dialogs: • The default value is now 7 days when selecting the daily retention option during tenant onboarding, when adding a new repository, and when editing retention on an existing repository. • Input validation has been added: the number of days must be between 1 and 10,000. An error message is displayed if the value exceeds the allowed range. • The Keep Retention option has been renamed to Unlimited for clarity and consistency. • Fixed an issue where users with the Restore Operator role received an error when attempting to access the Search page. • The first column heading has been standardized across all table views for a consistent user interface experience.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Backup Policy and Reporting Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-05-28|Microsoft 365 Backup Policy and Reporting Improvements
item.description: • The Backup Policy create and edit pages have been updated with UI/UX improvements, making policy configuration clearer and easier to use. • Optimized the backup policy creation flow to handle large backup scopes more reliably and efficiently. • The Express Backup edit policy behavior has been updated to correctly reflect the options available in the Express plan, aligning it with the intended product rules. • Fixed an issue where audit log entries for SharePoint site restores to another location were missing details, causing restore activity to be recorded incompletely. • Increased the report service timeout to reduce failures during long-running report generation.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Express Backup and Graph API Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-05-26|Microsoft 365 Express Backup and Graph API Improvements
item.description: • Added required Microsoft Graph permissions to Veeam Data Cloud app registrations as part of the transition from EWS to Graph API. New customers receive these permissions automatically; existing customers receive them upon reauthorization. For more details, see KB4820. • Added an in-app notification on the Dashboard prompting existing customers to reauthorize their app registration to receive updated Microsoft Graph API permissions in order to continue protecting Kiosk, F1, and F3 mailboxes. For more details, see KB4820. • Updated storage size labels from GB/TB to GiB/TiB in the Storage Consumption widget and related areas to accurately reflect binary unit measurements. • The Express Backup Policy create and edit experience has been updated with a refreshed design, preserving all existing functionality.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Backup Visibility and Management Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-05-18|Microsoft 365 Backup Visibility and Management Improvements
item.description: • The Dashboard has been redesigned with a new layout and visual style, providing an improved overview of backup storage and licensing activity. • Users with the corresponding admin permissions can now add new backup repositories located within the same region and increase the retention period on existing repositories from the tenant Settings page. • The Backup Policy items list now displays the count of selected items alongside the total number of items, making it easier to track the scope of a backup policy. • Fixed an issue where large session logs were split across multiple export files. The backup session log export now includes all items in a single file.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Multiple Microsoft 365 Express Backup and Restore Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-05-12|Multiple Microsoft 365 Express Backup and Restore Improvements
item.description: • Fixed an issue where the Microsoft 365 Storage Usage widget on the Dashboard displayed an incorrect list of users, grouping all users together instead of showing them individually. • Updated the Dashboard with improvements to the License Activity and Storage Consumption charts. The License Activity tile now shows current Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 licensed user counts and recent changes. The Storage Consumption tile now displays the top repositories by Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 storage usage. • Express backup now surfaces more granular item protection statuses, including Protected, Retrying, Unsupported, and Failed. New filter options allow users to narrow the view by status. Items with errors display a description to help understand the issue. • Administrators can now offboard individual protection units from Express protection. After offboarding is initiated, backed-up data is retained for 90 days. Offboarding can be cancelled within the grace period, which restores the standard 1-year retention. • Added the ability to cancel an in-progress offboarding of an Express protection unit. Cancelling restores the standard 1-year data retention for the affected items. • Users can now offboard individual protection units from Express backup. During the 90-day grace period following offboarding, data remains available for browsing and restore. After the grace period, data is permanently deleted. • The Express backup deactivation flow now uses a browser-based authentication experience (OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow), replacing the previous device code method. • Aligned the app registration permission set for Express backup with the required Microsoft 365 Backup Storage specification. • Introduced a dedicated restore page for data protected by Express policies, streamlining the restore process. • The Express restore view now includes Status and Expiring Date columns for mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint sites, and supports Offboard and Cancel Offboarding actions directly from the list. • Updated the restore confirmation message for Express protected data to more clearly explain which mailbox items will be restored, replacing the previous misleading wording. • When browsing items protected by Express policies, the view is now filtered to show only the mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint sites within the scope of the user's assigned access permissions. • Re-introduced the Mass Mailbox Restore advanced option, which allows restoring recent emails first within a configurable time window (default: 7 days). • When restoring Outlook emails or OneDrive files to an alternate location in a multi-geo environment, users can now type a destination address directly instead of selecting from a dropdown. Input is validated for correct format. • The app registration reauthorization flow has been updated to use a standard browser-based authentication experience (OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow), replacing the previous device code method. • Fixed an issue where retrying onboarding for a previously failed tenant did not validate whether the Microsoft 365 account being connected matched the domain name from the original onboarding attempt. • Improved the experience when tenant provisioning encounters an issue. Users now see a clear, actionable dialog indicating whether they can retry onboarding, reactivate Express backup from Settings, or contact support. • Administrators can now configure a default storage region for backed-up users and sites whose Microsoft 365 preferred data location is missing or invalid. This setting is available during onboarding, in the multi-geo mapping configuration, and in Settings → Multi-Geo Mapping. • Audit log now records events when a user opens Flex backup data for browsing, views items during restore configuration, or views Outlook items through Basic or Advanced Search. • Users can now change the backup repository password after it has been initially configured. • Simplified notification settings by consolidating individual user email preferences into the shared Email Recipients list. The My Preferences section has been removed from notification settings. • During an in-progress search, the result count now displays "Calculating…" instead of "0", making it clear that results are still being retrieved.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Admin Consent Validation Fix
item.guid: m365|2026-05-04|Admin Consent Validation Fix
item.description: Fixed an issue where validation of user-granted admin consent failed when a user's UPN contained a non-primary domain of the tenant.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] SharePoint and Flex Tenant Fixes and Enhancements
item.guid: m365|2026-04-21|SharePoint and Flex Tenant Fixes and Enhancements
item.description: • Fixed an issue where Flex tenant onboarding failed when a user's email address (SMTP) differed from their UserPrincipalName, causing a "Connect to EWS" error. • Resolved an issue where some SharePoint sites were missing for multi-geo tenants when selecting sites for a backup policy using the 'Get data from Microsoft 365 directly' option. • When restoring a SharePoint site to a different location, enable the 'Restore Permissions' option to preserve site membership and permissions.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] UI Refresh, Restore/Search Improvements, and Notifications Fixes
item.guid: m365|2026-04-15|UI Refresh, Restore/Search Improvements, and Notifications Fixes
item.description: • Refreshed the UI for the Activity, Reports, Notifications, and Threats pages to provide a cleaner, faster experience as part of the ongoing Veeam Data Cloud platform-wide redesign. • Corrected multiple UI labels for consistent branding and styling. • Standardized labels in notification recipient dialogs for a more consistent user experience. • Added tooltips for the Overwrite and Merge options on the OneDrive and SharePoint restore pages. • The “Restore channel members and their permissions” option is now available when restoring shared Teams • Fixed the issue where background downloads failed for larger files or when using download managers. • Updated SharePoint Basic and Advanced Search to properly handle folders and support accurate folder restores. • Enhanced the Notifications page by adding colored status icons, removing obsolete fields, and adding a Duration column to restore log details. • Fixed backup notification email templates for managed customers to correctly display the tenant name and backup date/time. • Added Overwrite and Keep options for OneDrive restores to the original location to ensure consistent behavior across restore workflows. • Added the Allow email preview option under tenant Self-Service settings, enabling self-service users to access View Details and Compare With Production. • Updated the Tenant Dashboard with refreshed License Activity and storage consumption charts: License Activity now shows the tenant’s VDC M365 license consumption. Replaced Highest Storage Users with the Storage Consumption chart showing repository usage. • Fixed an issue that generated unnecessary backup result notifications in managed tenant organizations. • Fixed an issue where excluded items were not handled correctly during backup policy creation. • Fixed an issue where CSV upload could misidentify personal vs. non-personal SharePoint sites when custom domains were used.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] New Exchange Search Experience
item.guid: m365|2026-04-13|New Exchange Search Experience
item.description: • An improved Exchange search experience designed to return results more quickly. • This update is currently rolling out and is expected to be fully deployed by the end of April 2026.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Veeam Intelligence for Microsoft 365
item.guid: m365|2026-04-01|Veeam Intelligence for Microsoft 365
item.description: What’s New Now available in Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365, Veeam Intelligence is an integrated, AI-powered assistant that helps users quickly access backup and restore best practices. Using natural-language queries, admins can get clear, contextual guidance for common tasks such as environment setup, backup and recovery requirements, basic troubleshooting, and restore workflows (e.g., “How do I restore a file?”). This reduces the effort needed to find answers and helps improve productivity. The result is more efficient backup operations and greater confidence when performing restores. Why This Matters Administrators often spend significant time searching for answers to routine setup and operational questions. Faster access to guided best practices can help reduce misconfiguration risk, accelerate troubleshooting, and simplify backup management—especially in larger environments where day-to-day operations can be complex. With Veeam Intelligence, admins can move from question to action faster, with confidence that their backup environment is configured correctly and running reliably. Getting Started Veeam Intelligence is included by default with Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365. To use it, customers must opt in for the organization. This can be found under Settings > AI.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Ransomware Detection Service
item.guid: m365|2026-03-31|Ransomware Detection Service
item.description: What’s New Ransomware detection is now available for Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 (coming to other Veeam Data Cloud workloads at a later time). Utilizing the Random Cut Forest algorithm, this new service leverages individualized behavioral profiles and anomaly detection to identify ransomware at the earliest possible stage for immediate remediation. Veeam’s proprietary detection provides the most accurate and comprehensive coverage across a wide range of ransomware strains. The service includes a threat center which combines both ransomware and Microsoft-provided malware alerts and details, for a centralized view of any threats to your data. Why This Matters Ransomware attacks are growing more frequent and sophisticated, targeting critical business data and infrastructure. Traditional detection methods fall short against modern threats, especially extended attacks that evade signature-based systems. Veeam’s ransomware system scans backups for subtle signs of intrusion—without burdening production workloads—using privacy-preserving and adaptive machine learning. This helps organizations stop attacks sooner, protecting profits, reputation, and sensitive information from extortion and damage. Getting Started The ransomware detection service is available within Advanced and Premium plans of Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365. Advanced and Premium customers will begin seeing Advanced Threat Detection capabilities in their tenants, starting with Premium customers first and Advanced customers shortly after.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Multi-Geo Restore Options, Expanded Notifications, and Files Version Protection
item.guid: m365|2026-03-31|Multi-Geo Restore Options, Expanded Notifications, and Files Version Protection
item.description: • When restoring SharePoint data to an alternate location, you can now choose the geo location within the same multi-geo tenant. • Fixed an issue where Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint downloads could fail for authorized users due to missing permissions. • The Notifications page is now available to all users, with content visibility determined by the user and tenant context. • You can now choose how many recent item versions to protect for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams files. Protecting only the latest versions can improve backup performance and reduce throttling risk. Configure this via the new Files Protection option in tenant Settings under Backup Options.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Express Restore Improvements, Multi-Geo Enhancements, and Teams/UI Updates
item.guid: m365|2026-03-25|Express Restore Improvements, Multi-Geo Enhancements, and Teams/UI Updates
item.description: • Express restore experience improvements: Added a notification when the selected time range contains no restore points for the chosen objects. Also Improved usability of the FastRestore points and date/time selection controls. • Added multi-geo tenant detection and region mapping to the setup and onboarding flow, including the ability to set retention per storage region and, in Tenant Settings, allowing authorized users to view and edit Microsoft location mappings via the Multi-Geo tab. For multi-geo tenants, Flex backup policy creation now supports filtering backup objects by protected tenant locations, and Flex restore workflows have been enhanced to display PDL tags for Outlook and OneDrive, while SharePoint restores to alternate locations now validate site-alias regions. • Microsoft Teams channel message protection is now enabled by default during Flex tenant onboarding. • The Backup Repositories tab now appears by default in tenant Settings for users with tenant admin permissions, listing repositories and their retention settings. • Renamed Teams Files to Shared across the UI to match the Microsoft Teams app interface update. • Tenant administrators can now control whether self-service users can preview emails during restores via Allow email preview (tenant Settings > Access). • Express protection policies now support CSV-based user selection for Exchange and OneDrive. • Updated Manual Connection field labels during tenant onboarding for clarity. • Fixed an issue where VCSP direct onboarding could fail if the Microsoft authorization URL was copied and opened in a new tab. • Fixed an issue where exporting Teams posts produced MSG files instead of a consistent HTML format. • Fixed an issue where Express backup listing/search could return duplicate sites with identical IDs. • Renamed Teams Chats to Posts across the Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 UI to align with the Microsoft Teams app interface update.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Entra ID Group-Based Role Assignments
item.guid: m365|2026-03-23|Entra ID Group-Based Role Assignments
item.description: In the Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 unified experience, you can assign user roles using Entra ID group-based role assignments.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] SharePoint and Restore Fixes with Express Activation Correction
item.guid: m365|2026-03-16|SharePoint and Restore Fixes with Express Activation Correction
item.description: • Fixed an issue where SharePoint sites could appear protected by Express backup policies but were not available for restore. • Fixed an issue where restoring a single mailbox folder from Flex backups could restore the entire mailbox. • Fixed an issue where content from certain SharePoint subsites did not appear during browsing or restore, and fixed the Load more behavior. • Fixed an issue where a region mismatch could prevent Express backup policy activation after re-onboarding a previously deleted tenant.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Microsoft 365 Tenant Onboarding, Validation, and Authorization Enhancements
item.guid: m365|2026-03-02|Microsoft 365 Tenant Onboarding, Validation, and Authorization Enhancements
item.description: • Increased the speed of validating SharePoint sites uploaded to a Flex protection policy via CSV file. • Updated the user interface and improved the onboarding flow for Microsoft 365 tenants in Veeam Data Cloud, including an option to opt in to Express connection. • Resolved an issue where reauthorizing Veeam Data Cloud in your Microsoft 365 tenant could fail with the error: “Consent action for Application failed due to the following error: The service principal name is already present for the tenant.”

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Improvements to License Notifications
item.guid: m365|2026-02-25|Improvements to License Notifications
item.description: • Resolved an issue where self-service users were incorrectly receiving license notification emails, ensuring security and privacy settings are preserved.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Comprehensive Usability, Security, and Reporting Enhancements for Backup and Restore Operations
item.guid: m365|2026-02-10|Comprehensive Usability, Security, and Reporting Enhancements for Backup and Restore Operations
item.description: • Flex restore session logs (Original location, Another location, and Save options) now include the user who performed the restore, making it easier to track restore actions. • Enabled granular mailbox restores from Express backups. You can now search for specific emails within a mailbox using advanced filters—sender, subject keywords, participants, and attachments—and restore them. • The SharePoint site URL now appears in the Bulk Restore wizard for Express, making it easier to identify sites with identical names. • Express policy protection units can now be filtered by error, helping users quickly identify failures. • Simplified the restore download experience by removing the “Local Computer Download” option and consolidating downloads into a single background download flow with clear in-app and notification messages, allowing customers to quickly access restore files regardless of size. • Self-service users can now be granted permission to restore their full mailboxes or OneDrive accounts using the “Allow entire objects restore” setting. By default, they can only restore individual Outlook and OneDrive items, reducing the risk of accidental data loss. • The default history restore option is now set to “Merge” when restoring SharePoint data from Flex backups with the “Restore only the latest version” setting. • Actions for OneDrive, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams "Download in background" operations are now included in the Activity page filter to simplify locating relevant records. • A warning now appears when a user edits a backup policy and attempts to leave the page without saving, prompting confirmation to avoid losing changes. • The report list is now reordered alphabetically on the Generate Report and Schedule Report pages, and new protection reports for OneDrive, Teams, and SharePoint—each listing items with their URL, organization, protection status, and last successful backup date—are available for on-demand generation and scheduled delivery. • Implemented a 90-day expiration policy for Veeam Data Cloud Public API keys. Expired keys are automatically rejected during authentication, and the UI now displays each key’s expiration date and time. • Deprecated the ability to use an additional app registration for SharePoint backups; the tenant settings no longer include the “Allow multiple additional applications” option. • Legacy unsupported actions—“Create Portal Session,” “Cancel Subscription,” “Resume Subscription,” and “Resume Organization”—have been removed from the Action filter on the Activity page.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] OneDrive Restore and Express Policy Stability Fixes
item.guid: m365|2026-02-04|OneDrive Restore and Express Policy Stability Fixes
item.description: • Resolved an issue that caused restores to another user's OneDrive to fail with a “OneDrive not found” error. • Fixed an issue where Express backup policies for a tenant in a multi-region environment became stuck in the ‘Updating’ state.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Product Improvements, Security Enhancements, and Reliability Updates
item.guid: m365|2026-01-22|Product Improvements, Security Enhancements, and Reliability Updates
item.description: • Removed unnecessary permissions from the Microsoft Entra ID enterprise application used by Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 to connect to Microsoft 365 organizations, and perform backup and restore of the organization data. • Enhanced the user experience for adding users to a Flex backup policy: the upload dialog header and hint now indicates that CSV or text files with one email address per line are supported. • Updated Express backup policy objects selection to include only supported objects (User, Shared user, root SharePoint site), filtering unsupported sites from CSV uploads. • Fixed an intermittent issue where background download jobs failed to generate a download link after users refreshed the operation list. • Fixed the issue where Search and Advanced Search across Outlook data for large tenants did not load or loaded indefinitely. • Fixed a duplicate error when activating Microsoft 365 Backup Storage for an onboarded tenant. • Blocked access to workload tenant details for users without permissions instead of showing an error message and the Access Denied page after clicking the Manage button. • Updated report functionality: report descriptions now clearly explain the data shown in each report, and generated report file names are standardized across Generate and Schedule flows, using the ReportName_DDMMYYYY_HHMMSS.csv format for Backup Summary, Restore Activity, and Backup Policy Detail reports. • Enhanced search reliability and performance for protected Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook data.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Multiple Restore Operation Issues and Reporting Issue Resolved
item.guid: m365|2026-01-06|Multiple Restore Operation Issues and Reporting Issue Resolved
item.description: • Fixed an issue where the Restore Activity Report would fail to download. • Resolved an issue where wrong SharePoint list name ("documents") was displaying during restores. • Corrected a problem where SharePoint restore operations would fail with the error "A task was cancelled" when the operation status was repeatedly refreshed. • Resolved an issue that prevented SharePoint site names from displaying when editing an Express backup policy.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Enhancements to Backup Policies, Processing Performance and Monitoring Improvements
item.guid: m365|2026-01-06|Enhancements to Backup Policies, Processing Performance and Monitoring Improvements
item.description: • Updates to the Flex Backup Session view to display retry attempt details, improved session log formatting for retries, updated status labels, and protected object counts for all statuses. • Flex backup policies now enable uploading a CSV file listing the SharePoint site URLs to protect. • Express backup policies are now updated to display a summary of units protected by the policy, showing counts of protected, in-progress, failed units, and the total. The policies now show protection status for each unit and include search and filter options. The status of protected objects within a policy can be viewed, searched and filtered within a policy. • Optimizations have been made for SharePoint site browsing of Express backup policies to resolve performance issues. • Removed the limit for deleting more than 30 protection units from an Express backup policy. Now any number of items can be removed with paging support for large lists. • Improvements have been made to the background processing of a number of items. These include saving Teams files and posts, supporting channel and item-level operations. Improvements were also made to the background processing for saving SharePoint libraries and folders, OneDrive folders, files and Exchange mailbox items. • Enhancements made to SharePoint site search and tree loading for large organizations. • Updates to the Operation Detail dialog in the Notifications section by clarifying texts and removing the "Activity Type" parameter from background report downloads. • Updates to the notification names and descriptions for report downloads in the Notifications section. Updates to the column names in the Backup Summary and Restore Activity reports were made for clarity, and total restore type records were moved to the end of the Restore Activity report.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Top-level Views Now Support Microsoft 365
item.guid: m365|2025-12-17|Top-level Views Now Support Microsoft 365
item.description: • Monitoring for Microsoft 365 is now available in both the Org Dashboard and Activity view in Veeam Data Cloud. Administrators can view protection status, backup history, and platform activity for Microsoft 365 alongside other supported workloads – all from these consolidated views. Support for additional workloads is planned. Explore the user guide in the Help Center for detailed information about the organization dashboard, activity view and audit logs.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Self-Service Activation for Microsoft 365 Backup Storage Billing
item.guid: m365|2025-12-15|Self-Service Activation for Microsoft 365 Backup Storage Billing
item.description: • Users can now enable Microsoft 365 Backup Storage billing directly from settings without Veeam team assistance. Express protection policies are available immediately after activation, streamlining setup time.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Multiple Restore and Search Issues Resolved
item.guid: m365|2025-12-15|Multiple Restore and Search Issues Resolved
item.description: • Resolved a 500 error message returned when retrieving the list of Teams posts. • Fixed an issue where SharePoint restore failed with the error "A task was cancelled" after a user refreshed the operation status multiple times. • Corrected a problem with advanced and basic search where the form would refresh and return no results after adding a search string and selecting a filtered object. • Fixed a delay when removing SharePoint sites from a protection policy.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Teams Chat Backup, Reporting, and Error Handling Updates
item.guid: m365|2025-12-09|Teams Chat Backup, Reporting, and Error Handling Updates
item.description: • Resolved authorization and timeout errors that occurred when disabling Teams Chat backup due to missing application ID. • Updated descriptions for Mailbox Protection and User Protection reports for consistency. • Reporting now reliably handles long error messages, preventing failures during report updates.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Self-Service Access, Restore Options, and Policy Management
item.guid: m365|2025-12-09|Self-Service Access, Restore Options, and Policy Management
item.description: • Tenant admins can now enable or disable self-service access for end users, enabling these users to restore their own Outlook and OneDrive data protected by Flex backup policies to the original location. • Bulk restore for Express policies now supports restoring large data sets to alternate locations. • Express protection policies are now editable while in the “Updating” state. • Up to 100 Express protection policies can be created and managed per Microsoft 365 application (Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive). • Objects can be imported into Flex or Express backup policies via CSV upload for faster policy configuration. • SharePoint lists can be restored to a specific target list. • The Restore Activity report includes a month and year picker to select a specific period for report generation.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] BYOK Encryption
item.guid: m365|2025-12-03|BYOK Encryption
item.description: What's New Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 now includes Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) encryption - also known as Customer-managed Encryption Keys - as a Limited Availability Preview. Only customers of Veeam Data Cloud for Microsoft 365 Premium can participate in this early access program. Why This Matters With a customer-managed encryption key, organizations retain full control over their data while benefiting from the scalability and convenience of as-a-Service solutions. This capability empowers organizations to host, manage, and control their own encryption keys, and, if needed, revoke Veeam Data Cloud’s access at any time.Important: There are risks associated with using customer-managed encryption keys. If a key is lost or deleted, access to all encrypted data is permanently lost and cannot be recovered. Getting Started Premium customers can enable BYOK by following the steps outlined within the BYOK Encryption section of the Veeam Data Cloud User Guide, and then contacting Veeam Customer Support to request access.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Teams Channel Notification Delivery Issue Corrected
item.guid: m365|2025-11-24|Teams Channel Notification Delivery Issue Corrected
item.description: • Addressed an issue where Veeam Data Cloud notifications sent to a configured Teams channel failed with the error “Teams channel incoming webhook URL is invalid”. The intended messages now deliver successfully to Teams channels.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Expanded Restore Options, Improved Usability, and Policy Management Enhancements
item.guid: m365|2025-11-17|Expanded Restore Options, Improved Usability, and Policy Management Enhancements
item.description: • Added the ability to restore Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive items from Express backups to a new location. • Enhanced backup session log downloads to support up to 10,000 records per file, allowing export of complete session logs to CSV. • Added a details section for Express policies, enabling visibility into protection status and issues for each object within a policy. • Improved the restore experience by disabling dropdowns and introducing a dialog for user selection (displaying both name and email), and by providing clear error messages when restoring SharePoint items to invalid or non-existent locations. • Added the ability to retry failed tenant provisioning, allowing setup issues to be corrected and onboarding to be reattempted without restarting. • Removed the “Acceptance” step and additional cost warning when activating Team Chat protection to streamline setup.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Reliability, Performance and Validation Fixes Across Backup and Restore Operations
item.guid: m365|2025-11-17|Reliability, Performance and Validation Fixes Across Backup and Restore Operations
item.description: • Fixed the issue where selecting “Use the latest available restore point” could trigger restores from an older state. • Fixed the issue causing a 500 error when retrieving backup policy data for a tenant. • Fixed timeout issues when browsing SharePoint backup data. • Optimized Advanced Search and on-demand report generation for large data sets, reducing wait times for results and reports. • Improved file upload validation in backup policy: existing users in the file are now skipped with a warning, while valid new users are added. • Admin email validation on onboarding a tenant via manual connection is now case-insensitive, preventing errors during onboarding.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Resolved SharePoint Site Limit and Outlook Backup Browsing Issues
item.guid: m365|2025-11-10|Resolved SharePoint Site Limit and Outlook Backup Browsing Issues
item.description: • Fixed an issue where updating an Express protection policy with more than 30 SharePoint sites failed to add sites exceeding the 30-site limit. • Resolved an issue that caused Outlook backup browsing to fail with the "Unexpected error occurred" message.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Resolved Issues with Restore Point Display and Exchange Download Links
item.guid: m365|2025-11-04|Resolved Issues with Restore Point Display and Exchange Download Links
item.description: • Fixed an issue where restore points appeared empty when selecting the first or last day of the month. • Fixed an issue that prevented download links from being provided after Exchange background downloads.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Resolved Issues with Notifications, Search and Restore Operations
item.guid: m365|2025-10-27|Resolved Issues with Notifications, Search and Restore Operations
item.description: • Fixed the issue that prevented email notifications from being sent on backup results. • Fixed an issue in Advanced Search where restoring SharePoint folders could fail due to invalid validation. • Fixed an issue where user selections were not retained or displayed correctly when restoring a mailbox to another user. • Fixed selection persistence in Advanced Search results to ensure user selections remain when navigating or performing actions.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Channel Member Restore, Group Selection, Logging, and Policy Management
item.guid: m365|2025-10-27|Channel Member Restore, Group Selection, Logging, and Policy Management
item.description: • Added a new option for Teams restores that allows private team channel members and their permissions to be restored, in addition to entire channels. • When selecting groups for an Exchange or OneDrive Express policy, the new "Search Microsoft 365 directly" option allows retrieval of the latest groups based on the current production state. • The backup policy session and session log dialog views now provide more accurate and focused information on processing. • The Logs tab in the restore operation dialog now displays the duration of each restore action.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Resolved Issues After Migration to Unified Experience
item.guid: m365|2025-10-21|Resolved Issues After Migration to Unified Experience
item.description: • Fixed an issue preventing new users from being added to a backup policy. • Fixed an issue where admins were not synchronized after the migration. • Corrected the total licensed users count.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Expanded Restore Options for Express and Flex Backups
item.guid: m365|2025-10-07|Expanded Restore Options for Express and Flex Backups
item.description: • Users can now restore Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive data from Express backups to an alternate location. This requires the “Restore to different location” RBAC permission. • Bulk restore is supported for both Express and Flex backups. Select and restore multiple mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, or SharePoint sites from Express backups, and multiple mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, or teams from Flex backups. Full RBAC permissions on the selected objects are required.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Resolved Backup Policy Errors and Warning Status Inconsistency
item.guid: m365|2025-10-07|Resolved Backup Policy Errors and Warning Status Inconsistency
item.description: • Removal of false error message when creating or updating a backup policy. • Warning status is fixed to ensure it's visible at all times when filtering within the session logs under "View Details".

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Resolved Restore and Export Failures from Search and Advanced Search
item.guid: m365|2025-09-26|Resolved Restore and Export Failures from Search and Advanced Search
item.description: • Restoring a site or site content from the search results page no longer fails with the error 'Cannot get site information to restore'. • Restoring or exporting items found using the Advanced Search option no longer fails with the error 'Failed to initialize restore'.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Restore Point Availability Issue Resolved
item.guid: m365|2025-09-22|Restore Point Availability Issue Resolved
item.description: • Restore points created on the first or last day of the month are now consistently available for browsing and restore operations at all times.

item.title: [Microsoft 365] Session Log Detail Improvements
item.guid: m365|2025-09-22|Session Log Detail Improvements
item.description: • Session logs now display timestamps in local time, making it easier to track activity. An End Time column has also been added for clearer visibility into when each session completes.
